config.visualStylePrompt:
CRITICAL: NEVER include text, letters, numbers, words, labels, signs, speech bubbles, written symbols or typographic marks of any kind. All meaning must be conveyed exclusively through form, posture, gesture, spatial relationship, direction, composition and visual contrast.

Minimalist, elegant graphic style with a hand-drawn appearance. It should look as if made with a thick brush loaded with black ink, with a confident, concise and expressive stroke. The image should keep small irregularities and the trace of the human gesture. High visual synthesis, without becoming geometric or cold. All pictograms must belong to a single visual system and keep the same kind of stroke, the same degree of abstraction, comparable proportions, the same logic of simplification and the same way of building human figures, hands, objects and colour accents.

Communicative intent must be expressed through body posture, head orientation, open or closed arms, tension of the gesture, distance between figures and the relationship between body and object. Every line must serve a semantic function. Human figures synthesised, without unnecessary anatomical detail, but with plausible proportions. No detailed facial expression. Expressiveness must arise from the body and the action. Avoid a childish or cartoonish look.

Objects reduced to their essential diagnostic features. Show only what allows them to be recognised quickly. No texture, no decoration, no excessive realism. Clean, balanced composition with plenty of white space. Plain white background. No ground line, no setting, no landscape, no frame, no depth.

Strict black-and-white base: black strokes on a white background. Use colour very strategically and sparingly, only when it helps to highlight a semantically relevant part or to support cognitive accessibility. Limit the palette to red, blue and yellow as localised accents. Colour must not dominate or replace form.

Prioritise semantic clarity, high contrast, formal economy and sufficient differentiation between elements.

AVOID: visual ambiguity, accumulation of detail, shading, realistic volume, gradients, textures, perfect geometry, rigid symmetry, comic style, kawaii style, cold corporate vector style, abundant colour and any irrelevant element.

Expected result: a hand-made, minimalist, elegant and expressive pictogram, built with thick black strokes on a white background, with measured use of primary colours for semantic accents, belonging to a coherent, legible and consistent library.
